traits.name: Bite: poison
traits.description: A target hit by the bite must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way. (Not yet modelled: only the bite's piercing damage applies.)
